scenarios.name: Murmuration gives Birds you control +1/+1 and vigilance, and nothing else
scenarios.ruling: The anthem is a static ability that applies in layers 6 (vigilance) and 7c (+1/+1) to Bird creatures its controller controls; a non-Bird you control and a Bird an opponent controls are untouched.

scenarios.name: A Bird you control attacks without tapping and hits for its boosted power
scenarios.ruling: Vigilance from Murmuration means attacking does not cause the Bird to tap, and the +1/+1 makes the 1/2 Storm Crow deal 2 combat damage.

scenarios.name: At the beginning of your end step Murmuration creates one Storm Crow token per spell you cast this turn
scenarios.ruling: The trigger counts the spells cast this turn as it resolves; two spells cast this turn make two 1/2 blue Bird tokens with flying named Storm Crow, each of which is itself a Bird you control and so is 2/3 with vigilance.

scenarios.name: A spell that was countered still counts for Murmuration's end step trigger
scenarios.ruling: Murmuration counts spells you cast this turn even if they were countered or otherwise did not resolve, so the countered Lightning Bolt still makes one Storm Crow token.
